sources.prompt:
Extract and paint a new transparent original gameplay sprite source sheet for the approved Wudang sword combat. Ref 1 is the exact A2 artwork and poses. Ref 2 is the precise established Wudang Kiếm hero identity. Ref 3 is the pointed cast stance. Preserve the dark topknot, thin white ribbons, black vest, white/ivory sleeves and robe, dark shoes and one thin silver straight sword with small brass hilt. Six complete isolated full-body figures arranged in a perfectly regular 3 columns by 2 rows grid, in evenly sized spacious cells with VERY generous transparent gutters and about 10 percent padding on every side of each cell. Keep same drawing scale and hero height in all six cels, same center of planted feet. Each cel has exactly one visible body and sword, no ghost, ground, floor, shadow, background color, letters, gridlines or VFX. True alpha. Chibi, crisp detailed pixel art with stable raised three-quarter RPG camera. Action order left to right top row: fully extended thrust, cross-body inward LEFT cut with opposite shoulder loaded, broad outward RIGHT cut with blade visible to one side. Bottom row: crouched powerful overhead DOWN cut ending with tip near ground, upward cut with sword raised high at its end, calm cast pose feet planted pointing the sword directly toward target. Make the five first poses visibly different from one another in hip rotation, weapon angle and step. Do not draw thin transparent outlines that will disappear at gameplay scale.
All six face SCREEN RIGHT in the same stable elevated side-three-quarter direction. Keep sword and ribbons entirely within each cell. Visual attitude follows the A2 contact positions exactly.

Create a transparent original VFX source board by isolating the sword trails in the approved Wudang A2 and Q2 references. Ref 1 shows tight ink-and-silver normal cut art; ref 2 shows the seven-hit brighter alternating silver and ink trail looks; ref 3 shows the blue-white circular swordfall flash. EXACT rectangular 4-column by 2-row grid with equal-size cells and very spacious transparent gutters. No character, steel sword, shadows, ground, pixels of backdrop, captions, grid lines, visible squares or letters. True transparent RGBA. Crisp detailed game pixel-art VFX. Top row 1-4: single short pale silver upward diagonal crescent, single dark smoky ink downward sweep with bright silver leading edge, a single silver broad horizontal sweep, a single dark ink vertical downward crescent. Bottom row 5-8: single tall pale blue-white hook rising up, single low wide ink horizontal sweep with tiny dark drops, single strong deep ink outward arc with very clear bright ivory cutting edge, one isolated low circular blue-silver ground burst splash and a few sharp upward shards from a localized sword impact. Face every horizontal or diagonal FX toward screen right. Each cell is one coherent slash or single effect, leaving all cell edges empty. Maintain luminous feathered alpha and full silhouettes with no matte color.

Transparent game effects source board, two equally sized square cells side by side with wide clear gutters. On left isolate just ONE complete Wudang spectral sword from approved reference, blade tip pointing EXACTLY straight UP, bright pale-blue silver steel, dark-blue compact wrapped grip at bottom, small warm gold crossguard. Same long elegant Chinese straight sword design as the distinct blades in panel 2, silver blue with gold guard. Complete thin and crisp silhouette with no cropped tip, no long attached trail, enough clean alpha padding to rotate the asset 180 degrees in game. On right isolate just the simple flat blue-white circular target mark from panel 3, floor-projected low ellipse with four small outward sparks at compass points and transparent interior. No actors, no paving, no labels, no checkerboard, no shadow, no colored background, no other items. Crisp detailed RPG pixel art. Both cells entirely transparent except the one specified effect.
